p: בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג צח, א):
when the two Tablets of the Torah were given
from the side of the Tree of Life."
וּבַתִּקּוּנִים (תִּקּוּנֵי זֹהַר, סוֹף תִּיקּוּן מ׳, פ, ב):
And in the Tikkunim (Tikkunei Zohar, end of Tikkun 40, 80b):
אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: יוֹמָא חֲדָא וְכוּלֵּי,
"Rabbi Elazar said: One day..." and so on,
what Rabbi Akiva said to his students:
"When you reach the stones of pure marble,
as it says: 'He who speaks falsehood
לֹא יִכּוֹן לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי (תְּהִלִּים קא, ז).
shall not be established before My eyes'" (Tehillim 101:7).
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (חֲגִיגָה יד, ב),
This is as Chazal say in the Gemara (Chagigah 14b),
are the two letters yud, yud,
from which pure waters flow forth..." and so on.
This is based on what is said
בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רעג, א):
allude to the two yuds..." and so on;
to the two Tablets of the Torah, and so on.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
based on what is written in the holy Zohar
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג פ, ב, סוֹף הָעַמּוּד):
as it is written: 'The fear of Hashem is pure,
for it stands constantly in this purity
And this is what is said afterward
in the Tikkunei Zohar cited above:
"and they are Chochmah at the beginning
That is: Chochmah at the beginning
is the yud of the Name Havayah,
is the yud of the Name Adnus,
And it says: "Hidden things of wisdom —
(not as the reading of the new printings, 'which is beneath')
This is as we constantly say,
comes from the Dew of Atika,
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: תִּזַּל כַּטַּל אִמְרָתִי (דְּבָרִים לב, ב),
as it says: "My word shall flow like the dew" (Devarim 32:2),
how it comes down from heaven.
which is the inwardness of Keser Elyon.
And from the crown-tip of the letter yud,
it shines forth to Chochmah and Binah
And this is: "Hidden things from the Supernal Chochmah,
which is Keser," and so on;
הֲוָה מֹשֶׁה נָחִית לוֹן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְכוּלֵּי.
Moshe was bringing down to Yisrael..." and so on.
and Chazal expounded (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 16):
freedom from the Angel of Death;
and as is expounded in the Gemara:
אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם (תְּהִלִּים פב, ו).
the utterance "I am Hashem your God,"
the learning of Torah was implanted in their hearts,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּשִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה (א, ב).
as Chazal say in Shir HaShirim Rabbah (1:2).
did not come as a command to believe,
as in all the other Commandments;
the language of command does not apply,
for if one does not believe,
what good would a command do?
Rather, Hashem Yisbarach declared and promised
And this is the meaning of
the learning of Torah being implanted in their hearts
And with the utterance "You shall have no other gods,"
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts.
For the yetzer hara is called
אֵל זָר בְּגוּפוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם (שַׁבָּת קה, ב),
"a strange god within a person's body" (Shabbos 105b),
שֶׁהֵם בָּאִים עַל יְדֵי כֹּחַ זָר;
since they come about through a foreign force;
that the yetzer hara is like an uncircumcised man
and is not part of Yisrael at all.
And this is "god" — meaning a force,
And this took place at the Gathering at Har Sinai,
where there was then "engraved upon the Tablets" —
that is, upon the tablet of their hearts,
כְּמוֹ: עַל לִבָּם אֶכְתֲּבֶנָּה (יִרְמְיָה לא, לב),
as in: "And upon their heart I will write it" (Yirmiyah 31:32),
וְכׇתְבֵם עַל לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ (מִשְׁלֵי ג, ג),
and: "Write them upon the tablet of your heart" (Mishlei 3:3),
and as has been explained many times.
in the Tikkunei Zohar cited above:
"But they were not worthy, and they were broken and fell,
of the First Beis HaMikdash and the Second.
Because the vav flew away from them..." and so on.
וּשְׂפַת אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד (מִשְׁלֵי יב, יט),
and "truthful lips shall be established forever" (Mishlei 12:19),
"The fear of Hashem is pure, enduring forever,"
for it never departs from it.
and from subjugation to the kingdoms.
from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil,
from where the Torah was given
That is, it can also be,
for those who approach it from the left,
it was engraved upon the heart
and the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts.
This is not so with the second Tablets,
of which it is written: "Carve for yourself" (Shemos 34:1).
That is, even though there too
וְכָתַבְתִּי עַל הַלּוּחוֹת וְגוֹ׳ (שְׁמוֹת לד, א),
"And I will write upon the Tablets..." (Shemos 34:1),
and it is written: "And He wrote upon the Tablets
except one who occupies himself with Torah,"
expounding it from what is written, "Engraved upon the Tablets" —
while here it speaks of the present time.
that here, with the second Tablets,
that is, a person must first, by himself,
carve out and engrave the heart of stone,
and afterward the words of Torah
And He said to Moshe Rabbeinu, "Carve for yourself,"
so that he would give this power to Yisrael,
that they be able by themselves
to engrave and hew the tablets,
that is, the heart of stone.
And then they too will merit
as there was with the first Commandments.
And this is what it says:
"And because of this Rabbi Akiva said:
When you reach the stones of pure marble,
'the heart of a wise man to his right'
וְלֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ (קֹהֶלֶת י, ב) וְכוּלֵּי.
'and the heart of a fool to his left'" (Koheles 10:2), and so on.
That is, not to confuse them
from which water issues..." and so on.
That is: in truth there too
and as is written in the holy Zohar
that "all the fountains of the great deep" alludes to
the springs of the lower wisdom.
But there they are sunk in the depths,
and there are also "the turbulent waters,"
And these too are compared to water,
"Like the roaring of the seas they roar" (Yeshayah 17:12),
turning into a flood of water.
And this is what it says:
from where comes 'the heart of a wise man...'"
And do not say of the stones of pure marble
as if there were two kinds of water;
rather, in truth they are one water,
where there was "engraved upon the Tablets";
engrave into the heart of stone,
and then one merits as well
to be free from the yetzer hara
And this is what it says further:
and as Chazal say in the Gemara (Chagigah 14b):
Ben Zoma gazed and was harmed;
and Rabbi Akiva came out in peace."
And this is because truth and peace
as is written in Sefer HaBahir,
and truth and peace are bound to one another
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג יב, ב).
And this is what it says:
of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil
while these stones of pure marble
That is, just as it was
that the Tree of Life departed from them
and they fell, and there is separation between them —
'He who speaks falsehood shall not be established...'"
For in truth, with the second Tablets
there is also "engraved upon the Tablets,"
and one who occupies himself with Torah
and carves the heart of stone.
And this is what it says further:
וְהַיְינוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יד, ב)
that is, as Chazal say (Bava Basra 14b)
that the fragments of the Tablets
For with the second ones too,
and carves the heart of stone,
they will then merit what there was
which were from the side of the Tree of Life,
"The fear of Hashem is pure, enduring forever";
and as is written in the holy Zohar that we mentioned:
"for it stands constantly in this purity
that is, freedom from the yetzer hara.
when the time of Zman Matan Toraseinu arrives,
and "upon their heart I will write it":
that there be freedom from the yetzer hara,
which is the essence of the "free man"
And even though the world is judged by its majority,
and the whole defect has not yet been repaired
so that there be "and eat, and live forever,"
And as the Midrashim and the Yerushalmi call
death by the term "when he slept,"
וּכְתִיב: וַהֲקִיצוֹתָ הִיא תְשִׂיחֶךָ (מִשְׁלֵי ו, כב)
And it is written: "And when you awaken, it shall converse with you" (Mishlei 6:22) —
